text:
maria: Preflight: kicking off a controlled roll of ff/antenna (search-ranking tweak). Canary 5% in eu-west now. Pinning backend to v3.2.1 for this roll. Watch windows: 45m soak at 5%, then step to 20% if health looks good. Rollout notes attached. @sre_jake @anya pls watch latency & 5xx rates. deploybot will post canary metrics.

deploybot: Canary started for ff/antenna — cohort 5% — backend=v3.2.1. Health gates: p95 latency <= 140ms, error_rate <= 0.6%, embeddings_fallback_rate <= 1%.

sre_jake: Got it. I'll watch the dashboards: /dash/antenna-canary and set alerts. If p95 > 150ms or 5xx spike > 0.7% for 5m, I'll trigger rollback.

anya: Note: if KDPL saturation rises we should pin to fallback route model-route-v2. Also prefer not to step >20% until 30m stable. No region expansion until 50%.

devops_lee: Quick infra note — rolling back will unpin v3.2.1 and route to stable v3.1.9. Added a hang-guard to prevent autoscaling from masking latency signals.

maria: deploybot command used: `@deploybot start-canary --flag ff/antenna --percent 5 --pin backend=v3.2.1 --soak 45m`

ops-bot: metric alert subscription created: antenna-canary-watch @sre_jake @anya @maria

deploybot: Will post snapshots at +5m, +15m, +30m, +45m. If any health gate fails, rollback will be initiated automatically and notify this channel.

pm_kai: FYI product tracking: if rollout hits 50% without regressions I'll update release notes and notify growth for experiment tracking.

sre_jake: small spike in 5xx at +9m — investigating, looks related to a particular /doc/render route. Rolling back to 0% while we triage. `/deploybot rollback-flag ff/antenna` — initiated.

deploybot: Rollback initiated by sre_jake — flag ff/antenna set to 0% within 2m. Unpinning backend to v3.1.9. Notifying oncall and creating incident stub.

maria: Thanks — opening postmortem thread. Tagging infra and eng-ml for root cause. Will reattempt after patch + load test. :white_check_mark:
